Functional Requirements Summary: FR-1: Sign in with Firefly III personal access token and API base URL (must include /api); persist both in localStorage
FR-2: Four footer tabs after sign-in: Budget, History, Analytics, Settings
FR-3: Budget shows Income, Current, and Expense blocks; Expense block includes Firefly liabilities as Debt
FR-4: Account icon, color, and block order persist in Firefly preferences (moneta.accountAppearance.*, moneta.accountOrder.*)
FR-5: Hidden accounts use Firefly active=false and disappear from the app
FR-6: Create / edit / delete accounts and create / edit / delete transactions via Firefly API; balances refresh after mutations
FR-7: Record income, expense, and transfer by dragging an account onto another account
FR-8: Edit mode reorders accounts inside a block, including onto another page
FR-9: History lists all transactions with search, filters, sort, and scroll pagination; updates immediately after Budget mutations
FR-10: Analytics donut (expense breakdown) and line chart (income vs expenses) with month/year and tag filters
FR-11: Parameters bar and analytics totals convert into the wallet primary currency using Firefly exchange rates
FR-12: On reopen, show the last persisted query cache for this device, then refetch from Firefly
Resolved Questions: Icon, color, and account order are not Firefly account fields. Store them in Firefly preferences: moneta.accountAppearance.<accountId> and moneta.accountOrder.<block>.
Editing a current-account balance uses PATCH account (current_balance / opening balance), not a reconciliation transaction.
Debt maps to Firefly liability accounts and is rendered inside the Expenses block. Expense type stays Firefly expense. Type is not editable after create.

Cross-device sync is Firefly itself. Local cache is per device. Use TanStack Query + persist (localStorage or IndexedDB): paint last data immediately, refetch in the background. Do not refetch from scratch on every tab visit.
Hide account: PATCH active=false. Restore only in the Firefly UI, as the PRD says.
V1 UI copy is English. All user-visible strings go through i18n keys so a second locale can be added later.
Multi-currency totals convert with Firefly exchange rates into the wallet primary currency.
Budget pagination is a paged CSS grid, not a carousel library. Income/Current: one row. Expenses: as many equal-height 1fr rows as fit above the footer and dots.
Stack already chosen: Vite, React, Mantine (core/hooks/form/dates/charts), @dnd-kit, Phosphor, React Router, vite-plugin-pwa, generated @hey-api client in src/api.

Follow the existing src layout. Do not invent a parallel tree. Feature screens live in src/modules/<name>/ with components, constants, helpers, hooks, types, tests (see src/modules/budget). Shared UI goes in src/components. Cross-cutting helpers and types go in src/helpers and src/types. Routes are declared in src/constants/router.ts and src/router/AppRouter.tsx. Imports use @/. App already mounts BrowserRouter + AppRouter; Budget exists as a placeholder at /monetta/budget. Empty module folders for login, history, analytics, settings are already created. Extend them. Generated src/api is read-only except a non-generated configure file outside it (src/helpers).

Style with CSS modules colocated with the component: ComponentName.tsx + ComponentName.module.css in the same folder. Do not add a global styles folder per module and do not put component styles in a shared CSS dump.
Vitest tests for a module go in that module's tests/ folder (src/modules/budget/tests, etc.). Shared helper tests go next to the helper or in src/helpers/tests.
Non-Goals (Out of Scope for V1): OAuth login; only personal access token + URL
Offline writes or a mutation queue when Firefly is unreachable
Syncing the local query cache between phone and PC (Firefly is the sync)
Bills, piggy banks, rules, recurrences, webhooks, attachments, export
Russian (or any second) locale strings in V1
Redux, a second UI kit, a carousel library, Chart.js/Nivo
Native iOS/Android apps or device-only verification
